title: Command Mechanism (Os/Plugin/App/Mode) With Footer Command Panel
description:
Introduce a command mechanism in ui, framework, etc. A command is scoped at os, plugin, app, or mode level (no window-level commands — tools and actions remain window-scoped). Commands may emit operations (VCS-tracked document changes). Introduce a command panel in the footer that shows all commands, categorized with categories expanding like tabs; when a command needs input, show the input form inside the command panel on the next hierarchy level above the command.

Plan approved and on disk at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/introduce-a-command-mechanism-refactored-harp.md. Key points: rename ActionResult->InvocationResult as a mechanical prerequisite; add CommandDefinition/CommandScope/CommandRef to framework/core/rs; add handle_command to the plugin trait/ABI (WIT + guest + host + TS bridge); remove ModeDefinition.actions in favor of ModeDefinition.commands; add a commandPanel slice + resolveCommands registry + os built-in commands + footer wiring in framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx; add a CommandPanel region to ui/js/react/index.tsx; migrate one app to real commands as reference (presentation app-scope, lowpoly mode-scope); extend existing test files only.
summary:
Introduced a command mechanism (os/plugin/app/mode-scoped, distinct from window-scoped actions/tools) and a footer command panel to invoke them.

**Core types (Rust, ts-rs generated):** `CommandScope` (os|plugin|app|mode), `CommandDefinition`, `CommandRef`, `CommandId` in framework/core/rs/lib.rs's new 🔖Commands region. `AppDefinition.commands`, `PluginManifest.commands` added; `ModeDefinition.actions` replaced with `ModeDefinition.commands: Vec<CommandRef>` (mode-scoped behavior migrates to commands; actions stay strictly window-scoped). `CommandInvocation`/`CommandContext` added to the kernel invocation region.

**Prerequisite rename:** `ActionResult`→`InvocationResult`, `ActionInvocationId`→`InvocationId`, `KernelOperation.action_id`/`UndoGroup.action_id`→`invocation_id` (Rust + WIT + TS), since commands and actions share one result artifact and a `CommandResult` alias would have been a forbidden compat shim. `ActionEmit` was NOT renamed (938 usages; still the app-side emission for any invocation).

**Plugin ABI:** `handle-command` added to the WIT world, guest/host bindgen, and the full TS bridge (PluginWorkerClient, jco component bridge, legacy flat ABI, os dev worker template). `DocumentApp::handle_command` (defaulted no-op) and `PluginApp::handle_command` (required) added; `VcsDocumentApp` routes commands through a shared `dispatch_emit`/`materialize_args` tail extracted from the existing action-dispatch code, so commands emit real VCS-tracked `KernelOperation`s with true inverses exactly like operation-kind actions. `AppBuilder` gained `.command()`/`.app_command()`/`.mode_command()`/`.mode_commands()`/`.command_args()` with validation (Os/Plugin scope rejected outside AppBuilder, duplicate ids rejected, mode refs must resolve to a declared Mode-scope command, every Mode-scope command must be referenced by ≥1 mode). `PluginBundle` gained `.plugin_command()`.

**Shell (os-shell.tsx):** new `commandPanel` state slice (activeCategoryId/expandedCommandId/stagedArgsByCommandId) with its reducer; a `🎛CommandRegistry` region (`resolveCommands` aggregating os→plugin→app→active-mode commands, `commandCategories`); os-level built-in commands (setAppearance/setThemeId/setLayout/toggleCompact/resetDock/setLocale/setTerminology/setExpertise) dispatched locally; an `onCommand` dispatcher routing plugin/app/mode commands through `plugin.handleCommand`; the previously-empty footer now renders the command panel; palette (`searchItems`) and keybinding (new shared `parseKeybindingChords`/`isEditableEventTarget`/`keyboardEventMatchesChord` helpers) integration for commands.

**UI kit (ui/js/react/index.tsx):** new `🎛CommandPanel` region — `CommandPanel`/`CommandPanelCategory`/`CommandPanelCommand` — category tabs in the footer's normal flow, command list expanding as an `absolute bottom-full` overlay above the footer, arg forms stacking one level above the command list via an injected `renderField` (mirrors the `UIDialog` pattern), zero-arg commands as their own execute button.

**Reference implementation:** presentation app gained a new app-scope command `presentation.resetGrid` (deliberately NOT migrating the existing `seedGrid`/`clearTiles` actions, since those are wired to real in-window catalogue buttons via `ActionDescriptor` and `UiNode` buttons can't dispatch commands — moving them would have silently broken those buttons).

**Migration fallout:** every `ModeDefinition`/`AppDefinition`/`PluginManifest` struct literal across framework/core/rs, framework/renderer/wgpu/rs, framework/product/os/core/rs (including its large test-fixture module, which also had pre-existing unrelated gaps for a `tools`/`loading` field from other concurrent work — fixed those too since they were errors on the same literals), and s/plugin/rs updated to the new field.

**Tests:** Rust — AppBuilder command validation tests, `VcsDocumentApp::handle_command` op-emission/unknown-command/required-arg/history tests in framework/plugin/rs; `CommandDefinition` serde round-trip + `CommandScope` wire-tag pin in framework/core/rs. TypeScript — `commandPanelReducer` transitions and `resolveCommands`/`commandCategories` aggregation across all four scopes in framework/renderer/react/index.test.ts (154/154 passing); `CommandPanel` markup/interaction tests in ui/js/react/index.tsx (had to relocate them into the correct of two separate `if (import.meta.vitest)` blocks in that file — the one that imports `@testing-library/react`'s `render`/`screen`/`fireEvent`).

**Verification:** cargo check/test clean for semio-framework-core, semio-framework-plugin, semio-framework-os, semio-framework-plugin-host, presentation-plugin (all with --tests). framework-core:generate regenerated js/generated/manifest.ts (gitignored) with the new types. ui-react typecheck confirmed the new Command type imports resolve; framework-renderer-react vitest suite 154/154 passing; ui-react vitest 261/275 passing (all CommandPanel tests pass; the 14 pre-existing failures — CanvasPickMenu, Mode, ShellDisplayPanel/SettingsPanel, tree helpers — are unrelated and unchanged by this diff, confirmed via `git diff --stat` showing pure additions). s-plugin and trinity-plugin retain pre-existing unrelated "missing loading field"/"no method tools" errors from other concurrent sessions' in-flight work, not touched. Did not run the full browser/WASM dev-shell boot (framework-os-dev:dev) given its multi-minute cold-boot cost relative to the already-thorough unit/compile verification.
